info.title: Default title
info.description: Deepseek is providing various advanced LLMs used for tasks such as maths, coding and natural language reasoning.

id.description: A unique identifier for the chat completion.
id.title: ID

finish_reason.description: The reason the model stopped generating tokens.
finish_reason.title: Finish reason

index.description: The index of the choice in the list of choices.
index.title: Index

role.description: The role of the author of this message.
role.title: Role

reasoning_content.description: The reasoning contents of the assistant message, before the final answer.
reasoning_content.title: Reasoning content

message.description: A chat completion message generated by the model.
message.title: Message

logprobs.description: Log probability information for the choice.
logprobs.title: Log probability

choices.description: A list of chat completion choices.
choices.title: Choices

created.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chat completion was created.
created.title: Created

model.description: The model used for the chat completion.
model.title: Model

system_fingerprint.description: This fingerprint represents the backend configuration that the model runs with.
system_fingerprint.title: System fingerprint

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the generated completion.
completion_tokens.title: Tokens (completion)

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt. It equals prompt_cache_hit_tokens + prompt_cache_miss_tokens.
prompt_tokens.title: Tokens (prompt)

total_tokens.description: Total number of tokens used in the request (prompt + completion).
total_tokens.title: Tokens (total)

prompt_cache_hit_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt that hits the context cache.
prompt_cache_hit_tokens.title: Tokens (prompt cache hit)

prompt_cache_miss_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt that misses the context cache.
prompt_cache_miss_tokens.title: Tokens (prompt cache miss)

completion_tokens_details.description: Breakdown of tokens used in a completion.
completion_tokens_details.title: Token details

reasoning_tokens.description: Tokens generated by the model for reasoning.
reasoning_tokens.title: Reasoning tokens

usage.description: Usage statistics for the completion request.
usage.title: Usage

post.description: Creates a model response for the given chat conversation.

content.description: The contents of the system message.
content.title: Content

role.description: The role of the messages author, eg 'system'.
role.title: Role

name.description: An optional name for the participant. Provides the model information to differentiate between participants of the same role.
name.title: Name

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.
messages.title: Messages

model.description: ID of the model to use. You can use deepseek-chat.
model.title: Model

frequency_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
frequency_penalty.title: Penalty (frequency)

max_tokens.description: Integer between 1 and 8192. The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion, defaulted to 4096.
max_tokens.title: Max tokens

presence_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
presence_penalty.title: Penalty (presence)

response_format.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output.
response_format.title: Response format

temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.
temperature.title: Temperature

top_p.description: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.
top_p.title: Top_p

logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.
logprobs.title: Log probabilities

top_logprobs.description: An integer between 0 and 20 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.
top_logprobs.title: Top logprobs

is_available.description: Whether the user's balance is sufficient for API calls.
is_available.title: Is available

total_balance.description: The total available balance, including the granted balance and the topped-up balance.
total_balance.title: Balance (total)

granted_balance.description: The total not expired granted balance.
granted_balance.title: Balance (granted)

id.description: The model identifier, which can be referenced in the API endpoints.
id.title: ID

object.description: The object type, which is always "model".
object.title: Object

owned_by.description: The organization that owns the model.
owned_by.title: Owned by

get.description: Lists the currently available models, and provides basic information about each one such as the owner and availability.
